source_policy.fallback_rule: GitHub/yfinance, FinMind and TAIFEX may fill null fields only when the observation belongs to the same specified trade date/session date. Never silently overwrite a non-null canonical value or use a different trade date.
source_policy.trade_date_rule: U.S. cash-market observations use latest completed session Friday 2026-08-28. Taiwan FX/cash/OI use 2026-08-28. TAIFEX after-hours from 2026-08-28 15:00 to 2026-08-29 05:00 are attributed to the following regular trading session per TAIFEX; preserve the physical session window and do not substitute older night data.
source_policy.uncertainty_rule: When exact same-session data are not independently verified, retain null or flag validation_required. Different-date values must never be blended or silently overwritten.

breaking_news.headline: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh turns hawkish at Jackson Hole
breaking_news.summary: Warsh said inflation remains above target and the Fed still has work to do, pushing September hike odds sharply higher and lifting Treasury yields and the dollar.
breaking_news.market_impact: Rates-sensitive technology, small caps and gold weakened; U.S. equities ended modestly lower.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Higher discount rates are a near-term valuation headwind for high-multiple AI and semiconductor names.

breaking_news.headline: Semiconductors reverse after Nvidia post-earnings surge
breaking_news.summary: Nvidia fell about 4.6% and the SOX dropped about 3.5% as investors took profits after Thursday's AI rally.
breaking_news.market_impact: AI fundamentals remain strong, but rate sensitivity and positioning caused a sharp one-day reversal.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Negative Monday read-through for TSMC ADR-linked semiconductors, AI servers and high-beta component groups unless Taiwan night futures/rotation confirm resilience.

breaking_news.headline: U.S. consumer sentiment weakens while long-run inflation expectations stay elevated
breaking_news.summary: University of Michigan final August sentiment fell to 51.7 from 55.2 in July; long-run inflation expectations held at 3.3%.
breaking_news.market_impact: Growth sentiment softened while inflation expectations remained uncomfortable for the Fed.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Keeps global risk appetite sensitive to rates and the next U.S. inflation/jobs releases.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: AI chip complex gives back part of the post-Nvidia earnings rally
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Nvidia fell about 4.6%, TSM ADR fell 2.29%, AMD fell about 2.3%, and SOX fell about 3.5% after Thursday's surge.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Shows that strong AI demand is no longer enough to offset higher rates and crowded positioning every session.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Use U.S. RRG plus Taiwan Rotation to distinguish durable leaders from high-beta profit-taking candidates.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Marvell beats but stock sinks as AI expectations outrun near-term revenue timing
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Marvell reported Q2 revenue about $2.74B and adjusted EPS $0.94; Q3 revenue guide is about $3.15B, while FY2028 revenue outlook was raised to $18B. Shares still fell about 10%.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: AI custom-silicon expectations remain large, but investors are demanding clearer near-term monetization.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Relevant to ASIC, networking, advanced packaging and server supply chains; high expectations raise execution-risk sensitivity.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Apple and Microsoft buck the semiconductor selloff
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Apple rose 1.63% and Microsoft 1.68% while semiconductors weakened.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Megacap leadership broadened away from chips, helping limit index losses.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Supports selective consumer-device and enterprise-AI demand, but does not offset the semiconductor rate shock by itself.

major_earnings.headline: Q2 revenue and EPS beat; multi-year AI outlook raised
major_earnings.guidance: Q3 revenue about $3.15B; FY2027 revenue about $12B and FY2028 about $18B; investors focused on timing of Google/custom-chip contribution.

major_earnings.headline: Q2 beat and Q3 guide above consensus
major_earnings.guidance: Q2 revenue $96.22B, adjusted EPS $2.22; Q3 revenue guide $108B +/-2%.

major_earnings.headline: Enterprise AI and cybersecurity demand supported raised outlooks
major_earnings.guidance: Both companies raised key annual forecasts earlier in the week.

narration_points: 8月28日美股小跌，標普跌0.25%、那斯達克跌0.52%，Russell 2000跌約1.4%，市場從前一日AI追價轉向利率風險。
Jackson Hole上Warsh重申通膨仍高、Fed還有工作要做，10年期殖利率升至約4.72%，美元指數升至約99.66，黃金期貨重挫超過3%。
半導體是最弱主線：SOX約跌3.5%，TSM ADR跌2.29%，AMD約跌2.3%，NVIDIA則在財報後大漲隔日回吐約4.6%。
台灣8月28日現貨反而先漲0.77%，外資期貨淨空單降至約8萬3655口；但週五夜盤台指期在美股轉弱後約收45900點、較日盤參考價跌457點。
下週一台股不應只沿用週五現貨強勢，需用美股RRG、台股Rotation與最新夜盤三層確認AI、半導體、網通、PCB、散熱與電源的真實強弱。
